answer_2.quote: We evaluate the QA model trained on various question sets on three test sets.

answer_4.quote: We asked multiple annotators to answer these questions. These annotations served to eliminate ambiguous questions as well as those that cannot be answered from the provided paragraph.
answer_4.guideline: annotators could see all the different modified questions corresponding to a paragraph... each modified questions is also annotated individually to ensure that questions can be answered in isolation
